title: Sèvres or Lausanne?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Predict, term by term, which of ten terms of the 1920 Treaty of Sèvres the 1923 Treaty of Lausanne reversed and which it kept, then name the rule behind the pattern, the National Pact.

educational.topic: Turkish War of Independence and the Treaty of Lausanne
learningObjectives: Differentiate the terms of the 1920 Treaty of Sèvres that the 1923 Treaty of Lausanne reversed from those it kept, predicting at least 8 of 10 correctly and explaining the pattern by the National Pact.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, then reveal (term-by-term comparison table), followed by choosing the principle that explains the pattern
keyQuestions: Which terms of Sèvres did Lausanne reverse, and which did it keep?
What single rule predicts which terms survived?
Did Lausanne give Turkey full control of the Straits?
commonMisconceptions: Lausanne simply cancelled Sèvres, reversing every term.
Lausanne gave Turkey full control of the Straits at once, when that came only with the Montreux Convention of 1936.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt predictions on ten terms (mastery: 8 of 10) and the choice of explanation A.
Explain why the Straits regime counts as kept rather than reversed.
